rule: A Dream skill takes hold only of a mind that can see it (Light's half: you, or the thing you made, in its front arc with a clear line) or that is asleep (Dark's half); it ignores armour and shields, does +30% to the Dazed and the Asleep, its statuses last half again as long on them and a quarter longer on a target standing in Dim light - the twilight. Mindless things never feel it.

new_mechanics.name: twilight
new_mechanics.definition: Affinity key 'status_time_dim' (Dream 1.25): a status a Dream skill applies lasts that much longer on a target standing in Dim light (Light.level_at, neither Lit nor Dark); it multiplies with status_time_vs. needs_seen, bonus_vs_status and status_time_vs are built and unchanged.

skills.name: Dozing Mote
skills.summary: A slow, drifting mote: 45, and the target nods. The first mote Dazes it; a second on a Dazed target puts it to sleep for 4 s. It must see the mote coming.
skills.verb_fit: Sleep is to put to sleep: every mote pushes the target one step further down - awake, Dazed, asleep. The night's half of the twilight (Dark).

good_modifiers.word: A deep sleep: 6 s instead of 4.
A quicker mote, harder to step out of the way of.
A second, dreamt mote leaps on to one more target.
What it does not drop, it calms: the target stops starting attacks for a moment.

bad_modifiers.why: Its own opposite: a sleep bolt that rudely wakes its sleepers. The fallback adds +50% against Asleep targets, which this skill's own hit then wakes and cannot re-sleep (Wakeful).
Terror and sleep fight each other: the fallback makes the target flee instead of nodding, so the second mote never lands.
Shoving a body you are lulling makes no sense; the fallback knocks the target out of your pools and out of reach of the second mote.

skills.name: Lucid
skills.summary: For 6 s you are wide awake while they dream: your Dream statuses last 30% longer and your casts recover 30% faster. Your phantoms and every mind you have turned within 12 m share it: they deal 30% more, and a phantom takes one more blow to break.
skills.verb_fit: Wake is 'rouse; break a trance' - your own mind, and the minds you lead. The dawn's half of the twilight (Light: the clear morning mind).

new_mechanics.name: buff_targets
new_mechanics.definition: A self_buff with buff_targets ['self', 'summons'] also applies to the caster's summons within 'radius' (and any that come within it while it lasts): Thralls, phantoms (leave_decoy) and Charmed enemies. Keys that mean nothing on a summon are ignored; summon_deals_mult and phantom_extra_hits are read only on summons.

good_modifiers.word: Lucid for 9 s
It stays with you 30% longer
A calm waking: less reflux
Your turned minds share it from 16.8 m

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: putting yourself to sleep. The buff has no hit to carry Asleep; falls back
nothing it shoots. Falls back
a buff has no hit to carry a shove; falls back

skills.name: Doubling Step
skills.summary: Step 5 m aside and leave a phantom of yourself behind for 3 s. Enemies that were watching you go for the phantom instead; it breaks at the first blow.
skills.verb_fit: Conjure makes an illusion. The step only gets you out of the picture; the skill is the double left standing in it - Light's bent light (false images are Dream's now).

leave_decoy.fools: enemies that see you as you cast

good_modifiers.word: A phantom that holds them for 4.5 s.
A 6.5 m step, farther from the trap.
Out of the step a quarter sooner, free to act while they swing at nothing.
They keep believing it 30% longer.

bad_modifiers.why: Its own opposite: breaks the illusion it makes. The dash has no hit for its interrupt, so the fallback does nothing but undo the phantom.
Reveals the disguise you just put up; the dash has no hit to carry Read.
The step touches nobody, so there is no one to pin; the fallback does nothing.

skills.name: Shattered Dream
skills.summary: Every enemy within 10 m under one of your Dream spells wakes from it at once: 50 each, 100 to sleepers, and all of them are Dazed for 2 s. Your phantoms burst for 40.
skills.verb_fit: Dispel breaks illusions. Every spell you laid on the room is broken at once, and the breaking is the damage - Light's clarity, turned on your own dreams.

good_modifiers.word: Break every dream within 14 m.
A rude waking for the whole room: +50% on sleepers and more poise.
All of it, once: 20% harder.
They wake on the floor: 30% more poise damage.

bad_modifiers.why: Its own opposite: conjuring while breaking illusions. A detonate has no chain, so the fallback's extra jump does nothing.
It wakes them and then tries to put them back - and they are Wakeful, so the fallback only Dazes the already Dazed.
Nothing travels; the fallback has no speed to raise.

skills.name: Night Terror
skills.summary: For a moment you are the thing under the bed: everything within 4 m that sees you takes a blow and is Terrified for 2 s - it turns, runs, and will not attack.
skills.verb_fit: Dread is terror - fear of the dark (Dark's old Dread): the blow is small, the fear is the point.

good_modifiers.word: A wider terror, 5.2 m: the whole slot ring breaks.
They run for 3 s.
The fear sticks 30% longer.
They fall over themselves: 30% more poise damage.

bad_modifiers.why: Its own opposite: calm and terror cancel. The fallback Soothes them, which ends at once because the burst just hit them.
Pulling in the very enemies you are sending running is a contradiction; the fallback drags them 1.5 m closer as they flee.
Enraging what you are terrifying makes no sense (and frenzy is the enemy's tool); the fallback is just +20% damage for more essence.

skills.name: Quiet Hour
skills.summary: Point, 9 m: a hush 3.5 m across for 7 s. Enemies in it that see it are Soothed: they move 30% slower and start no attacks. Hitting one snaps it out.
skills.verb_fit: Soothe is calm and bliss: a steady soft light (Light's Glow) and a hush (Dark's Hush) - a patch of the fight where nobody wants to fight.

good_modifiers.word: A hush that lasts 10.5 s.
A wider hush, 4.5 m.
In the quiet the Dazed drop off: Soothed enemies that are Dazed fall Asleep.
The hush settles you as well: 20% less reflux.

bad_modifiers.why: Its own opposite: terror in a zone of calm. The fallback sends everyone in it running, out of the zone.
Enrage and soothe cancel; the zone deals no damage, so the fallback's +20% does nothing.
A shove every tick is a hit that breaks Soothed, so the zone would undo itself.

skills.name: Changeling Mask
skills.summary: One enemy within 10 m that sees you wears your face for 4 s. Its friends within 8 m that see it take it for you and attack it, and it fights back.
skills.verb_fit: Mimic is to take another's look. The look taken is yours, laid over an enemy in the half-light: Dark's Obscure, hiding one thing inside another's shape.

good_modifiers.word: The mask holds for 6 s: a proper brawl.
Mask the one at the back, 14 m away.
Fooling allies up to 10.4 m away.
The likeness sticks 30% longer.

bad_modifiers.why: Its own opposite: revealing the disguise you are laying. The fallback (Read) ends the mask on the same target.
Shoving the masked one away from the allies you want to fight it defeats the skill.
A gaze has no projectile to pierce, and Dream already ignores armour; the fallback does nothing.

skills.name: Read the Tell
skills.summary: One enemy within 12 m that sees you shows its hand for 8 s: every attack it starts can be interrupted, and any hit during its wind-up staggers it. Works on elites.
skills.verb_fit: Unmask reveals a disguise - the enemy's poker face. Light's half: what is hidden is shown.

good_modifiers.word: 12 s of its hand on the table: a whole Commander phase.
You keep reading it 30% longer.
Read it from 16.8 m, before it closes.
Read two of them at once.

bad_modifiers.why: Its own opposite: putting a mask on the face you are unmasking; the fallback Masks the target and the two statuses cancel.
A short read (4.8 s) often ends before the attack comes; the gaze has no damage for the +25%.
A gaze has no force; the fallback is a free shove that moves the target out of the reach you want to punish it in.

skills.name: Errand
skills.summary: Point, 10 m: the enemy nearest that spot that can see you (or is asleep) walks to it and stands there 2 s without attacking - into your pool, out of the line, away from the Drummer. A hit breaks it.
skills.verb_fit: Whisper plants a command: one order, 'go there', spoken in the quiet (Dark's Hush) and carried out as if it were the enemy's own idea.

good_modifiers.word: Send it to a spot 14 m away.
It stands there 3 s.
The two nearest walk.
It walks off without calling for help.

bad_modifiers.why: Putting it to sleep (or Dazing it) at the moment of the order means it never walks; the two words fight.
A Terrified enemy runs away from you, not to your spot; the fallback overrides the errand.
A shove is a hit, and a hit breaks the command; the fallback undoes the skill.

skills.name: Shutter
skills.summary: Point, 10 m: minds within 3.5 m that see it close up: 25, and for 8 s they cannot be Drummed or Roused, and cannot call for help or answer a call.
skills.verb_fit: Shut closes the mind to others: each one shut in its own dark (Dark's Obscure), cut off from the drum, the order and the cry for help.

good_modifiers.word: Shut a 4.5 m circle: the whole drummed line.
Closed for 12 s.
Drop it on the Drummer 14 m back.
A shut mind drops what it was about to do: it interrupts.

bad_modifiers.why: Its own opposite: planting a command in a mind you are closing; the fallback pulls them toward you.
Nothing travels; the fallback has no speed to raise.
Lifting bodies has nothing to do with the mind; the fallback is a free Updraft.

skills.name: Sweet Lie
skills.summary: One enemy within 10 m that sees you believes, for 5 s, that it is on your side. It turns on the nearest of its friends, and they answer it. It counts as your summon (Lucid reaches it); hit it yourself and the lie ends. Heavy enemies believe half as long; an elite is only Dazed.
skills.verb_fit: Charm is 'win a mind over': for a while it is yours. The warm light that draws the eye (Light's Glow) and the lie told in the half-light (Dark).

new_mechanics.name: charmed
new_mechanics.definition: 1 stack, 5 s: it fights for the caster - targets the nearest of its former allies, and they treat it as an enemy (Masked's lure, turned round); it counts as the caster's summon (buff_targets); it ends if the caster hits it; heavy_lasts_mult 0.5; elite_status 'dazed'. Uses the gaze check (sees_caster).

good_modifiers.word: A longer lie: 7.5 s
Turn the one at the back, 14 m away
It goes on believing 30% longer
A gentle lie: cooler on your reflux

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: planting doubt in the mind you are winning. The two statuses fight on one target; maths lets it act, it should not
a gaze has no force; the fallback is a free shove away from the friends you want it to fight
a gaze has no projectile to pierce, and Dream already ignores armour; falls back

skills.name: Misgiving
skills.summary: A cone 7 m long of things half-seen: every enemy in it that sees you takes 15 and is Doubting for 6 s - its wind-ups take half again as long and its blows land 30% softer. Heavy enemies and elites doubt for half as long.
skills.verb_fit: Doubt is 'plant doubt'. Twilight itself, both parents at once: in half-light nothing is certain, so nothing is done with conviction.

new_mechanics.name: doubting
new_mechanics.definition: 1 stack, 6 s: windup_mult 1.5, deals_mult 0.7 (both existing keys); heavy_lasts_mult 0.5, and elites keep it at half time too (no elite_status), so the enchanter has a slow for big enemies.

good_modifiers.word: Doubting for 9 s
A wider cone, a little softer
Doubt turned to dread: they are Terrified as well, and run
A longer cone, for the archers at the back

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: winning over the minds you are souring. Maths lets it act, it should not
a soothed mind is calm, not doubting, and Soothed ends on the cone's own hit; the fallback does nothing
a cone has no projectile to pierce; falls back

skills.name: Rousing Blow
skills.dropped_why: A heavy melee strike is a bruiser's; the enchanter does not hit hard. The sleeper payoff is Shattered Dream (100 to sleepers) and the rule's +30%; Wake now rouses your own mind and your summons (Lucid).
